lead: Test build 0.8.21 (CI run 39018067599, branch round-0.8.21): a direct .msi install removes the uninstall entries that earlier setup.exe installs left behind, the classic oscillator display shows the original's 64 waves and its Shape mix, and our code is built with full compiler warnings. A short round: two or three items per system. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Disposable DAW project only. No firmware or OS update, no "Burn To Flash", no factory reset, no storing patches.
Order: Linux (the Virus is here), then the Windows 11 VM, then macOS, and Windows 11 on this PC last.
Close the DAW before moving the Virus to another machine.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER via pw-jack, Virus on this PC
prep: Claude unpacked the test build to ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21-linux. In a terminal: cd ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21-linux/TI-Revive-0.8.21-linux && sudo ./install.sh

items.title: Smoke test
steps: Open the test project in REAPER and play the Virus track; open the editor.
items.expect: sound, the editor opens. (The editor shows no version; the plug-in itself reports 0.8.20 until the release, L2 shows that the new build is in.)

items.title: Classic oscillator display
steps: Init patch, oscillator 1 in Classic mode. Shape fully left (Wave), then step WaveSelect through 1, 2, 3, 10, 30, 64.
WaveSelect 1, then turn Shape from left through the middle (Saw) to fully right (Pulse), and move Pulsewidth at the right end.
items.expect: WaveSelect 1 a sine, 2 a triangle, every other number its own shape (not always a sine); Shape fades smoothly wave -> saw -> pulse, Pulsewidth moves the pulse edge. Write down anything that looks off (clipped, shifted, wrong size).

sections.title: Windows 11 VM
prep: Prepare: close REAPER. Claude hands over the Virus with VM=win11 scripts/vm.sh attach. 0.8.21 is installed in the VM with setup.exe.
notes: Claude already ran the uninstall-entry checks in the VM (no Virus needed): 0.8.20 setup.exe, then the 0.8.21 .msi directly: one entry, the five leftovers removed (bundles.log); then the 0.8.21 setup.exe uninstall and install: one visible entry, the clean-up stayed out of the way. W1 is only a look.

items.title: One TI Revive entry
steps: Settings, Apps, Installed apps: search for "TI Revive".
items.expect: exactly one entry, TI Revive 0.8.21 (before: the setup.exe's 0.8.20 entry would have stayed next to it).

items.title: Smoke test and oscillator display
steps: Open the test project in Ableton, play, open the editor.
Oscillator 1 Classic: WaveSelect 1, 2, 30 with Shape left.
items.expect: sound; sine, triangle and a third distinct wave, the same pictures as on Linux.

sections.title: macOS
prep: The Mac was asleep: the package is on this PC as ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21-mac.zip; Claude pushes and unpacks it to ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21-mac when the Mac is awake. Then in Terminal: sudo installer -pkg ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21-mac/"TI Revive.pkg" -target /
notes: The Mac reads the 64 waves from its own Access bundle binary; Claude checked that the table is found in the 5.1.7 Mac binary, but not inside the running plug-in.

items.title: Smoke test
steps: Start Ableton, play the Virus track, open the editor.

items.title: Classic oscillator display
steps: The same steps as L2 (WaveSelect 1, 2, 3, 10, 30, 64 with Shape left; then Shape from left to right and Pulsewidth).
items.expect: the same pictures as on Linux (WaveSelect 2 a triangle, not a sine).

items.title: Compare with the original (optional)
steps: Only if the original Virus Control still opens somewhere: set the same three combinations (WaveSelect 2 Shape left; WaveSelect 1 Shape middle; WaveSelect 1 Shape right, Pulsewidth middle) and take a screenshot of the oscillator display in both, original and TI Revive.
items.expect: the same curve, position and size; save the screenshots where Claude can read them for a pixel comparison (E180).

sections.title: Windows 11 on this PC
sections.where: boot into Windows; Claude is not available during it
prep: Prepare: in Windows, download the 0.8.21 .msi (not the setup.exe) from github.com/derpsn/access-virus-ti-revive/actions/runs/39018067599 (artifact "TI-Revive-msi", GitHub login).
notes: Before: Installed apps shows three TI Revive entries (0.8.0, 0.8.20 and 0.8.20). Do this block last and reboot to Linux at the end; Claude reads the install log read-only (C:\ProgramData\TI Revive\bundles.log).

items.title: The .msi cleans up the old entries
steps: Settings, Apps, Installed apps: search for "TI Revive" and note what you see.
Install the 0.8.21 .msi (double-click), then search again (close and reopen Settings).
items.expect: afterwards exactly one entry, TI Revive 0.8.21.

items.title: Smoke test
steps: Ableton: play the Virus track, open the editor, oscillator 1 Classic, WaveSelect 2.
items.expect: sound, a triangle in the oscillator display.
